title: Happy Shrimp
description: This spicy shrimp dish features a luscious sauce of tomatoes, cream, white wine, basil, and cayenne pepper. Serve with crusty bread or over hot pasta.
ingredients: 1 pound peeled and deveined medium shrimp
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Stir in shrimp, green onions, and garlic; cook and stir until shrimp are pink on the outside and no longer translucent in the center, about 5 minutes. Transfer shrimp mixture to a plate and set aside.
Add tomatoes, cream, wine, basil, and cayenne pepper to the same skillet. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until sauce coats the back of a spoon, about 10 minutes.
Add shrimp mixture to sauce in the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until heated through.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make a shrimp dinner that's earned its happy title. Shrimp is cooked with plenty of garlic, green onions, white wine, cream, fresh tomatoes, and basil. Serve this up with some crusty bread or hot pasta and watch this dinner disappear.
